compute_estimate.basis: local four-pool program-only profile; no cloud speed-equivalence claim

decision.inconclusive: runtime/oracle failure requires receipt audit, not automatic grid or retry

decision.positive: multiple productive rounds and score progress justify a matched fast-control comparison

information_regime.comparison: single development execution, no matched superiority claim
information_regime.initialization: reused task-independent exact structure lock, all queries charged
information_regime.pmo_history: task previously inspected; no historical PMO scores loaded
information_regime.previous_unresolved_query: unchanged charged reservation, not recovered here
information_regime.reference: not loaded; optimization proposal, not frozen-reference sampling

contract.metrics: per-query best/top-ten curve; budget-128 AUC diagnostic, not official 10k PMO result
